answer: Re-attestations are stored in lotus and nebula lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the comet graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1844 impostors cost 1853 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
